title: Jahmyr Gibbs signs $67.5 million Lions extension to become highest-paid running back in NFL history

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jahmyr Gibbs signs $67.5 million Lions extension to become highest-paid running back in NFL history
sources.description: Jahmyr Gibbs agreed to a three-year, $67.5 million contract extension with the Lions, making him the highest-paid running back in NFL history.
